1.

We have in heaven a High Priest, Who ever can have compassion, Who saves completely, preserves from fall, And strengthens us here on our path.

2.

And He Himself was tempted in all things as we are, All suffering He knows well, And stands by us in every trial, To help the tempted soul.

3.

We praise Thee, Christ, our High Priest! Now outside the camp we go, For within the veil is our place, Where we ever may worship.
